title: Japanese Macaroni Salad
description: A keto-friendly Japanese-inspired macaroni salad with a warm and crumbly twist.
instructions: Cook macaroni al dente and set aside.
In a pan, heat the warm sesame oil over medium heat.
Add crumbly furikake and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add sliced green onions and diced cucumber, cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in diced avocado, keto mayonnaise, soy sauce, and sesame seeds.
Combine cooked macaroni with the pan mixture and toss to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
